facts: The date parameter requests historical ticker information; security description, type, exchange and listing date reflect the security then.
SEC-derived fields are selected using the filing report-period date, which can precede filing/publication. This is not original historical availability evidence.
market_cap is described as the most recent ticker close multiplied by weighted outstanding shares.
weighted_shares_outstanding expresses other share classes as equivalent units of the selected class; share_class_shares_outstanding is class-specific.
limitations: The documentation alone does not prove every retained value uses August 3 regular-session close or shares effective at that close.
Date-qualified records still require source identity, currency, close consistency, contradictory-evidence and cutoff checks.

facts: Weighted shares represent whole-company common equity in the chosen class's units; class shares describe only that class.
A multi-class company's equivalent share counts can differ by conversion ratio across listings.
Repeated company-wide capitalisations from different class tickers must not be added as independent company values.
limitations: Equivalent units do not resolve class-price premiums, missing non-US common classes, ADR ratios or effective-date changes.
A source-qualified reconstruction is distinct from independently verified rank-day capitalisation, original historical receipt and final company-membership certification.
